reason: I've never paid for a creator tool and I get by on YouTube Studio, free vidIQ and ChatGPT. Mitra sounds like one more thing to set up when my problem is just that my videos don't get enough views.
objection: It says it will find my next video idea and deals, but nothing here shows it will get my views up. Connecting my channel to an AI I've never used is also a trust question I haven't answered.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real example from a channel my size where the weekly plan beat its usual views, plus a free trial that doesn't need a card.
